rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for saying that a claim or description goes beyond the truth or reason.

example.english: Saying he finished the whole report in an hour is a bit of an exaggeration.
example.traditional: 你話佢一個鐘頭就做完成份報告，呢個講法有啲誇張喎。
